questions.texte: Write a paragraph introducing your friend.

intitule: Create a Dialogue - At the Restaurant

enonce.texte: Instructions: Create a short dialogue (at least 6 exchanges) between a customer and a waiter at a restaurant. Use greetings, polite expressions, and complete sentences.

questions.texte: Write a dialogue at the restaurant.
questions.reponse: Example: Customer: "Good evening!" Waiter: "Good evening! Welcome to our restaurant." Customer: "Thank you. Can I have a table for two, please?" Waiter: "Of course. Follow me, please." Customer: "Thank you!" Waiter: "You're welcome. Enjoy your meal!"
